title: BLT Sandwiches
description: Crisp oven-baked bacon, ripe tomato and crunchy lettuce on toasted bread with mayonnaise. Simple, but only as good as the tomatoes.

image.alt: A BLT sandwich with bacon, lettuce and tomato, cut in half

steps.text: Line the baking sheet with foil or parchment and lay the bacon on it in one layer. Put it in a cold oven, then set the oven to {temp 400F oven}.
Bake until the bacon is browned and crisp, {time 17-20 min} from turning on the oven. Drain on paper towels.
Toast the bread and spread each slice with mayonnaise.
Sprinkle the tomato slices with the salt and pepper. Layer lettuce, tomatoes and three slices of bacon on half the toast, then close the sandwiches and cut in half.

notes: Baking bacon means no spatter and flat, evenly crisp strips. Let the fat cool before throwing it away; never pour it down the drain.
